en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Douai
en.summary: A Host found on the ground is said to have risen of its own accord, with the face of a child appearing on the cloth it touched.
en.body: In 1254, a Host found lying on the ground in Douai reportedly rose into the air on its own, and the face of a child appeared upon the cloth it had touched, later said to transform into the crowned and bleeding face of Christ.
